note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by Mr. S. J. Crail at the Lisburn Union offices on 3 May 1933. Eight nominations were received for fifteen seats and the other seven were filled by the retiring members. The nomination for Magheramesk was declared invalid. Polling in County Antrim took place on 1 June 1933. Returned unopposed.
